accepted.sentence: At dusk, riders switch on front and rear lamps so other road users can see them and the path ahead.
When locking outdoors, pass a sturdy lock through the frame and a wheel, then secure it to an immovable rack.
To repair a puncture, remove the wheel, lift one tire bead with levers, and patch or replace the damaged tube.
Before crossing railway tracks, approach nearly at a right angle to keep narrow tires from slipping into grooves.
A handlebar mirror lets riders check traffic behind them with brief glances while keeping their forward view available.
On a tandem, the front rider steers and brakes while both occupants coordinate pedaling to keep their effort synchronized.
Before riding through a puddle, riders slow down because its depth and hidden hazards may be difficult to judge.
At a curb, riders can unweight the front wheel slightly, then shift their weight to help the rear wheel roll over the edge.
